memoryIntro: Inspect committed state and manuscript evidence by disclosure boundary and story time. Author view does not grant Writer knowledge.
chooseCharacter: Query first, then choose a character
evidenceQuery: Evidence queries (one per line, up to four)
includeStructure: Include existing character, ideas and clue evidence
stateWarning: Historical views use confirmed chapter-end states, not unrecorded exact instants. Missing or stale history is not filled from current profiles.
noHistoricalState: No verifiable historical state. Check commit receipts and source versions.
selectKnowledgeCharacter: Choose a character and query again. Author truth does not grant character knowledge.
noEvidence: No verifiable evidence within this scope.
textNotTruth: Narration may report a claim, lie or flashback. A search match does not establish objective truth.
interpretation: Uses existing literary records; author interpretation, plans and committed facts remain separate.
planned: Author plan, not an occurred fact
staleEvidence: Missing or stale evidence; review again
dependencyCycle: A strict-order cycle exists. Review it in the logic workbench.
dependencyPolicy: Only declared strict-order dependencies are checked. Associations and social feedback are not causal proof.
history_UNKNOWN: Insufficient history for a reliable state
history_VERIFIED_PROJECTION: Historical projection with verified commit receipts
history_LEGACY_VIEWS_ONLY: Legacy records include history gaps; those parts retain only existing views
editorialIntro: Uses existing full-text reading and checkpoints. Choose intent, scope and dimensions, preview costs, then run bounded batches. Suggestions never edit prose automatically and produce no literary total score.
goal: What should the editor focus on?
noLetter: No valid edit letter for this reading unit yet.
opinion: These are scope-limited editorial judgments. Unreliable narration, flashbacks, open endings and deliberate style changes are not automatically errors.
statisticsNotice: Local observations use resumable batches. Sentence length, dialogue ratio and repeated sentences are descriptive, not literary scores or reliable speaker attribution.
workflowSaved: Project editorial preset saved. Applying still requires a fresh preview and execution confirmation.
epistemic_NARRATOR_ACCOUNT: Narrator account, not independent factual proof
incompleteEditorial: Reading or synthesis is incomplete. Current opinions are not a complete book assessment.
